key_points: Justin Boxford named CEO of Capri Holdings (CPRI) effective January 2027, bringing nearly 30 years of luxury sector experience from Estée Lauder and LVMH
Estée Lauder (EL) stock is considered 'fully priced' after an outlook upgrade, with last close at US$112.33
EL unveiled a new Skin Longevity Platform (Mastering Skin Longevity) connecting research to future product pipelines
Analyst upgrades from Citigroup and BofA Securities support the stock's long-term growth potential
Outlook supported by China beauty product rebound, travel retail recovery, and broader luxury sector tailwinds
